entry.title: New: Resolution 359 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO BIG ISLAND RESOURCE CONSERVATION AND DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL FOR REIMBURSEMENT OF EXPENSES RELATED TO THE 37TH ANNUAL BIG ISLAND PRO-AM SURFING TRIALS

Transfers $1,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 4)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 359-23 - 12/06/23
